notes: The ASV's textual note reports a different Greek reading, but the projection carries the base text and every source token is realized, so rule 97 does not arise.
The supplied *as* at t010 belongs to the predicate accusative κύριον that licenses it (rules 7, 11) and is not added.
ἐάν is an ordinary conditional and is aligned to *if*; rule 72's generalizing arms are not in question.
